zh-CN.name: 新粗野主义
zh-CN.description: 在界面中使用鲜明描边、硬边阴影、直接的排版和明显色块来突出结构。它通常比传统网页粗野主义更受控，但醒目的外观不能替代清楚的操作层级。
use_when: 品牌需要直接、鲜明且易识别的视觉性格。
少量关键操作需要强烈的可见边界。
avoid_when: 所有元素都同样抢眼会破坏层级。
不要用错位与密集描边牺牲文本和触控空间。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
采用清晰粗描边、少量高对比色块和硬边阴影；优先突出主操作，正文保持安静易读；组件间距和焦点提示一致，阴影不遮挡相邻内容。
专属演示：粗描边、实体偏移投影与色块，按下时投影收拢并显示本地反馈。 参数：描边 {border_px}px；投影偏移/扩散 {shadow_px}px。

en.name: Neubrutalism
en.description: An interface style using bold outlines, hard shadows, direct typography and distinct color blocks. It is often more deliberately composed than web brutalism; visual boldness still needs clear interaction hierarchy.
use_when: The brand benefits from a direct and distinctive visual character.
A few key actions need highly visible boundaries.
avoid_when: Making every element equally loud destroys hierarchy.
Do not sacrifice legibility or touch space for offset shadows and dense outlines.
en.prompt_template:
Use clear bold outlines, a limited set of contrasting color blocks and hard shadows. Give the primary action priority while keeping body content quiet and readable. Maintain consistent spacing and focus cues; shadows must not obscure adjacent content.
Dedicated demonstration: Thick outlines, hard offset shadows and color blocks; pressing contracts the shadow and displays local feedback. Parameters: border width {border_px}px; shadow offset/spread {shadow_px}px.
